neighbours.label: a problem getting resolved: the outcome word (fixed, solved, corrected, rescued, repaired)
fire: The leak in the roof was finally repaired after three weeks of rain.
Engineers say the software bug can be fixed with a simple update.
After two days on the ice, the stranded climbers were rescued by helicopter.
Surgery to correct the heart defect was scheduled for the spring.
Detectives believe the old case will be solved with new DNA evidence.
The billing error was corrected and the customers got refunds.
Once the pipe was mended, the water pressure returned to normal.
The dispute was settled when both sides signed the agreement.
quiet: The leak in the roof finally got worse after three weeks of rain.
Engineers say the software bug can spread through a simple update.
After two days on the ice, the stranded climbers were spotted by helicopter.
Tests to describe the heart defect were scheduled for the spring.
Detectives believe the old case will be discussed with new DNA evidence.
The billing error was noticed and the customers got letters.
Once the pipe was inspected, the water pressure stayed low.
The dispute was reported when both sides read the agreement.

notes: Top: correct, fixed, solved, rescued, surgery. - pole: 'can prevent/can slow' (possibility of help).
